title: A dock with a little gravity
description: Nearby tools grow gently as the pointer passes across a compact dock.
useCase: Add pointer feedback to a small set of creative tools with recognizable icons.
interaction: Move across the tools, then select one
reducedMotion: Tools stay at their original size. Touch and keyboard use stationary native buttons.
limitations: Fixed-size buttons translate and scale together; the backing surface scales independently. Motion values avoid React renders per animation frame, but spring evaluation still runs in JavaScript. Large docks need overflow handling and performance testing.
look: Light grey page with a translucent off-white dock holding four pastel rounded-square tool icons in sage, tan, blue-grey and lilac, captioned above.
motion: As the mouse moves along the dock, each tool springs from 44 to 64 px according to its distance from the pointer within 115 px; leaving springs them back.
adapt: The `sizesAt` function maps distance within 115 px to a visual size from 44 to 64 px. Each `DockItem` uses that result to translate and scale a fixed 44 px button, packing neighboring tools without animating layout. `useSpring` smooths pointer position and emphasis; `shellScale` sizes the backing surface independently. Replace the `tools` labels, colours and icon paths; keep mouse-only magnification and stationary keyboard/touch behavior.
